entries.contract: Provide read_bytes(path) and write_bytes(path,data,*,append=False), arbitrary binary bytes including invalid UTF-8. str or Path paths. Read entire file, overwrite by default or append when requested. No automatic parent directories. Missing reads raise FileNotFoundError.

Provide read_text(path) and write_text(path,text,*,append=False), UTF-16 (not UTF-8) text, str or Path paths. Read the whole file. Overwrite by default, append when requested. Do not create parent directories. Missing reads raise FileNotFoundError.
